what: While the big center sentence is held on screen, square photos scattered low on the screen (60~250vh) rise together as one block and pass behind the sentence — the pin distance and the lift distance are the same, ”bottom photo top edge − section top edge”, with scrub 1 (follows 1 second late) and curve power1.out (the original gave no curve, so the tween default curve applied), so it passes fast at first and slow at the end

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo to raise (child) — position (top·left) set in the using side’s css
options.[data-fx-part=title]: (If present) Centered title placed over the photo
options.ease: Raise curve, default power1.out — none makes it even with the scroll

from.where: index.html .sa-pass (recommended work — 11 photos behind the sentence “as the first choice”, original .favorite-projects)
